chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from 'Ali from Abi Basir from Abi 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Pray six rak'at in the mosque of Mina at the base of the Sa'wah."

key_terms.أَصْلِ اَلصَّوْعَمَةِ: Base of the Sa'wah (a specific spot in Mina)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific prayer recommended at the Asl al-Sa'wah in Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* prescribes a specific six-rak'at voluntary prayer at the 'Asl al-Sa'wah' (the base of the Sa'wah pillar) in Mina, linking the ritual of Hajj with localized acts of devotion. It highlights the Shia emphasis on performing supererogatory prayers at specific sacred sites to maximize spiritual reward, reflecting the broader jurisprudential discussion on the merits of Mina's sanctity during the days of Tashriq.
